|Skip to contentExtreme heat persists throughout the week
From Tuesday through the rest of the week, daily highs will hover between 110 and 111 degrees. Early models suggest next weekend won’t bring much of a cooldown.A First Alert has been issued as temps climb back above 110 degrees in the Valley Monday through Saturday, adding to an already brutal summer.The extreme heat settles in on Monday with a high near 110 degrees, kicking off a hot workweek where temperatures will range between 110 and 112 degrees.An Extreme Heat Warning is in effect for the Valley from Monday through Friday evening, with First Alert Weather Days declared as high temperatures are expected to reach 110 degrees or higher.
